findings.evidence: Ch 4, PDF p. 103: "roughly ~37 hosts on the u-only screen at a 70% target utilization (⌈430/(17 × 0.7)⌉ = ⌈430/11.9⌉ = ⌈36.13⌉) — or 39 hosts before the spare, 40 under the book's provisioning policy" and "The occupancy form and the host-count form therefore agree here (40 provisioned / 39 working)" | Ch 8, PDF p. 173: "with N full-utilization hosts, total = ⌈N ÷ (0.7 × 0.95)⌉ = ⌈N ÷ 0.665⌉ and working = total − 1 ... The utilization-only (ρ = 1, no 95% N+1 term) screen is total = ⌈N ÷ 0.7⌉ — 30 for KV-only, 32 for case (ii)"
findings.issue: The two forms Ch 4 says 'agree' do not agree at the intermediate utilization-only screen the same paragraph quotes. The occupancy form gives ⌈430/(17 × 0.7)⌉ = ⌈36.13⌉ = 37; Ch 8's canonical host-count form applied to the same case (N = ⌈430/17⌉ = 26 full-utilization hosts) gives ⌈26 ÷ 0.7⌉ = ⌈37.14⌉ = 38. They coincide only at the final policy stage (40 provisioned / 39 working) because the two rounding paths happen to land on the same integers there. The mini-case never states the host-count form's ρ-only value, so the one-host divergence is invisible to the reader.
findings.fix_instruction: In Ch 4 §4.8, state the host-count form's utilization-only figure (38) alongside the occupancy form's (37), and add one sentence noting that the two forms differ by up to one host because of where the rounding occurs, so the reader does not read 'therefore agree here' as general equivalence.

findings.evidence: PDF p. 85: "GQA/MQA and sparse attention shrink the KV constant several-fold (Ch 7), so ~2.62 MB/token is a deliberate upper bound and Appendix A §7's Fig A.2 (vendor-relative KV/compute ratios) is its deliberate relaxation, not a correction."
findings.issue: The Preface states the cross-reference convention explicitly: 'Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form: a bare § N.M refers to chapter N, section M'. 'Appendix A §7' violates that form — an appendix subsection must be cited as § A.7 (the book's own apparatus uses 'A.3', 'A.6' elsewhere, e.g. 'Appendix A, A.6 carries a boxed 2026-09-27 capability probe'). The bare '§7' also invites the wrong reading — Ch 7 is a different chapter, whose §7 is 'Memory Is the First Constraint'.
findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite as 'Appendix A § A.7's Fig A.2' (or simply 'Appendix A's Fig A.2, vendor-relative KV/compute ratios'), and sweep the body for any other bare '§N' used against an appendix.

findings.chapter: Ch 4 (The Anatomy of an AI Workload), §4.8 mini-case
findings.evidence: p.103: 'i.e. 2,472.5 per GPU, which Ch 8 Table 8-1 prints as ~2,471: the same rate rounded differently'. Table 8-1 (p.171) actually prints 'prefill throughput per GPU ~2,472 tokens/s … 346.15 TFLOPS ÷ 140 GFLOP/token = 2,472.5 → 2,472', and §8.3.4 (p.172) repeats '2,472.5 ≈2,472'. No occurrence of '2,471' exists in Ch 8.
findings.issue: Cross-reference misquotes its target: Ch 8 Table 8-1 prints ~2,472, not ~2,471, and 2,472.5 rounds to 2,472 — the claimed rounding discrepancy ('the same rate rounded differently') does not exist.
findings.fix_instruction: Change '~2,471' to '~2,472' and delete the 'the same rate rounded differently' clause.

findings.evidence: Bare single-part section refs, malformed under the book's own convention (Preface p.20: 'a bare § N.M refers to chapter N, section M'): Ch 5 p.118 uses both '(§5.3(a), §7)' (bullet 1) and '(§5.7)' (final paragraph) for the same open-questions target, and p.109 repeats 'the §5.3(a)/§7 item'; Ch 6 p.128: 'see §6 for the conditions under which it pays' (intended §6.6); Ch 7 p.153 '§1' twice ('decimal 80×10^9 B basis, §1… still fails — §1'), p.155 and p.161 once each (intended §7.1), p.154 '(§4 point 4)' (intended §7.4 item 4) — while the same chapter uses the full form '§7.3' (p.156). Also Ch 4 p.84: 'Appendix A §7's Fig A.2', a section form inconsistent with the Preface's 'A.3'/'A.6' usage (p.19); the List of Figures attests only figures A.1–A.5.
findings.issue: Cross-reference format violations with misread risk: under the stated convention a bare '§7' parses as Ch 7 §(nothing) and invites a Chapter-7 misread; bare '§1'/'§4'/'§6' are undefined forms; the Appendix A section naming is inconsistent with the rest of the book and its §7 target is unattested in the available front matter.
findings.fix_instruction: Expand every bare ref to the full form: §5.7 (pp.109, 118), §6.6 (p.128), §7.1 (pp.153 ×2, 155, 161), §7.4 (p.154); normalize 'Appendix A §7's Fig A.2' to the A.M form (e.g. 'Appendix A §A.7') or cite the section that actually hosts Fig A.2.
